# Kenney Castle Kit — curated subset

- Author: Kenney
- Official page: https://kenney.nl/assets/castle-kit
- Downloaded: 2026-10-27
- License: Creative Commons CC0 1.0 (`LICENSE.txt` beside this file)
- Original package: `kenney_castle-kit.zip`

Only the pieces used on Michael Island are kept: hexagon towers for the bridge gates and receivers (`tower-hexagon-base`, `tower-hexagon-top`), gate banners (`flag-banner-long`), and underside boulders (`rocks-large`).
